additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing well.
When the ticket was reported, the error flag
DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101
was active, but that error flag has now been cleared
.
You should, preventively, check these connections so that it doesn't happen again.
Since this error is no longer present, let me know if this information is enough for you to troubleshoot.
Now, it is showing a new error flag: Missing Converters in DC4. We need to check for any loose connections related to the power converter with Serial No. 2102312VGQLUNA000119SA002200000200. If necessary, we should consider replacing the converter.
Also, please find below attached steps and knowledge article.
Troubleshooting Steps:
Check for any loose connections to all the power converters.
Use a multimeter to verify the input to the power converter is within the permissible range.
Identify the missing converter by their serial numbers and verify if they are powered on.
If a converter is missing or not powering on, swap it with a known working one and check if the replaced converter powers on.
Examine the power converter display for any errors or if it shows any light.
If all the above steps have been performed and the power converter still does not power on, please proceed with replacing it.
Also refer below mentioned KA to resolve the reported issue.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_SW+HW_Converters_Missing converters in Error Flags - Dynamics 365
